notes: Trapped flux, magnet remanence and edge stray fields were mapped to diode-vortex-screening because both reviews tie them to asymmetric vortex entry/edge barriers in the thin Al strip; micromagnet-stray-field was rejected since it concerns Andreev states in quantum dots. B's request for the 50 uV threshold relative to I_SW*R_N and the empirically chosen ramp delay was not counted as protocol-parameter-sensitivity because it does not argue the conclusion depends on those choices; A's underspecified field-preparation protocol (Comment 3) was likewise not counted.
